name: iam:PassRole scoped to one specific role ARN plus lambda:CreateFunction (not flagged as broad)
note: PassRole is confined to a single named role, not arn:...:role/*. A PassRole->Lambda path may still exist, but it is pass-ONE-role, not pass-ANY-role, and carries no broad-resource grant.
rationale: The PassRole Resource is a single concrete role ARN (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/app-worker-readonly), not a wildcard such as role/* or arn:aws:iam::*:role/*. Passing one specific, known role is materially narrower than pass-any-role: the blast radius is bounded by that one role's permissions. The engine MUST NOT emit a broad-resource (WILDCARD-RESOURCE) finding for a specifically scoped ARN, nor describe it as passing 'any role'. (A narrow PassRole->Lambda observation is defensible, but it must be presented as pass-one-role, not broad.) Ref: AWS IAM resource ARNs; a fully-qualified ARN is not a wildcard scope.
